description: Add POST /api/teams/{id}/ask (+ optional opponent_id) that lets the user ask the assistant about their team. Build grounded CONTEXT from: the team's hydrated slots, the deterministic analysis report (T-006), and RAG retrieval for any species/mechanic the question references (reuse the existing router + RetrievedChunk path so citations work). Reuse app/rag/answer.py streaming + system prompt discipline: answer ONLY from provided context, cite [n], and abstain honestly where DB lacks the fact (e.g. exact competitive tiers/movesets not ingested). Stream via SSE like /api/ask. Returns analysis-backed 'what to improve' when an opponent is supplied. Respects llm_enabled (503 when no key, by design).
title: Team-aware RAG coach endpoint (SSE, grounded, cited)
